.name: Filter my Steam library
.note: Filter the current Steam library by individual fields. Never launched: status=[{op:"equals",value:"unplayed"}]. Most played: sortBy=playtime_minutes and direction=desc.
.description: Filter the current Steam library by individual fields. Never launched: status=[{op:"equals",value:"unplayed"}]. Most played: sortBy=playtime_minutes and direction=desc.
.parameters.1.description: Sort field. Defaults to name for the library and wishlist order for the wishlist.
.parameters.2.description: asc for ascending (default), desc for descending.
.parameters.3.description: Take this many results after sorting all matches. Omit to return every matching AppID.
.parameters.official: Original Steam name. Pass op and value per condition, or omit this parameter.
